flags: BOOKING CHANGE ANNOUNCED: 'These sites will be reservable in 2027' (mycountyparks, Linn County's text). The entry should move to reservable on mycountyparks.com when 2027 booking opens.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stays not waterfront): the stored evidence ('Morgan Creek meanders SE beyond wide wooded/wetland buffer, beyond distance bound') understates it. Morgan Creek is ~6-8 m wide at the campground (creek class), and the two or three pads on the east end of the loop (around 41.9891,-91.7622) end ~20-25 m from the bank, across a grass strip and a riparian shrub/tree belt; the loop's own road separates the other pads from the creek, and a trail with a footbridge crosses it at the south. The bank is wooded, so no open land to the water; with no site photo showing otherwise it stays not waterfront.
